mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_objects (unreferenced_at, owner_id, owner_type, storage_key, original_name, content_type, size_bytes, status, created_at) VALUES (#{createdAt}, #{ownerId}, #{ownerType}, #{storageKey}, #{originalName}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_id, owner_type, storage_key, original_name, content_type, size_bytes, status, created_at FROM file_objects WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE file_objects SET status = #{status}, unreferenced_at = CASE WHEN #{status}='USED' THEN NULL ELSE UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) END WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_images WHERE file_object_id = #{fileObjectId}
